key.skirmish.friends.toggle: Friends: add/remove the player under the crosshair
skirmish.module.friends.name: Friends
skirmish.module.friends.description: A friend list: /skirmish friend add|remove|list <nick> or a key on the player under the crosshair. Friends' nicks are colored.
skirmish.module.friends.setting.list.too: Edited with /skirmish friend and the key
skirmish.module.friends.setting.color_na: A friend's nametag gets the chosen color (invisible players' nametags are left alone)
skirmish.module.friends.setting.marker.t: Put ★ in front of a friend's nick
skirmish.module.friends.setting.clanshar: Players whose ClanShare labels you added on this server count as friends (while this is on)
skirmish.module.friends.setting.import_c: Add every ClanShare label sender on this server to the list, once
skirmish.module.friends.setting.key.tool: Add or remove the player under the crosshair (not through blocks)
skirmish.module.friends.setting.show_lis: Show your friends in chat (only you see it)
skirmish.friends.not_found: %s is not in the friend list
skirmish.friends.empty: No friends yet. Add one: /skirmish friend add <nick>
skirmish.friends.remove_hover: Fill in the command to remove %s
skirmish.friends.import_none: No new ClanShare senders on this server
skirmish.friends.blocked: Friends are not available on this server
skirmish.friends.module_off: The Friends module is off: the list is kept but not used
